rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone or something is extremely or incredibly so.

example.english: The desserts at this restaurant are fantastically delicious.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲甜品勁好食。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 tim4 ban2 ging6 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this when the extreme degree is presented as outrageous, absurd, or crazily beyond normal limits.

example.english: The concert tickets are fantastically expensive.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 gwai3 dou3 ci1 sin3
